1 لَحَنَ He erred in speech; spoke incorrectly. (Msb.) ―
-b2- لَحَنَ لَهُ He said to him something which he (the latter) understood, but which was unintelligible to others: (Az, S, Msb, K:) he intimated to him something which he (the latter) alone understood.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
